newsitem.title: USA: Limited Inc Q3 net rises vs yr-ago proforma.
newsitem.headline: Limited Inc Q3 net rises vs yr-ago proforma.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: The 1995 results are pro-forma to reflect the impact of 1) the IPO of a 16.9 percent interest in Intimate Brands Inc, 2) the sale of a 60 percent interest in the company's previously wholly-owned credit card bank, World Financial Network National Bank (WFN), and 3) a reduction in weighted average outstanding shares reflecting the company's self-tender of 85 million shares which was consummated effective March 17, 1996.
The net income figures exclude gains from initial public offerings.

The company reported 1996 third quarter gains of $118.6 million, or $0.44 per share, from the Abercrombie & Fitch Co initial public offering. In 1995, the company posted third quarter gains of $613.5 million, or pro-forma $2.24 per share, from the initial public offering for Intimate Brands Inc.
The 1996 third quarter operating income increased 28 percent to $88.4 million, compared to pro-forma operating income of $69.1 million last year.
